subject: Evaluation-track recommendation & trial acceptance checklist
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan@clearvale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation-track recommendation & trial acceptance checklist

Morgan — thanks again for a great discovery call earlier. Quick recap and a recommended path so we can lock dates and owners. I kept this intentionally short and actionable.

Call summary (2 lines):
- You want to validate that Redwood reduces manual review time for clinical coding suggestions while preserving recall on high-risk entity matches.
- Primary constraint: PHI cannot leave ClearVale environments; prefer staging/VPC-based validation.

Two candidate evaluation tracks we discussed:
1) Offline batch evaluation (fast, low-friction)
   - Redwood runs on a sanitized sample dataset you provide in our staging S3 or via secure upload.
   - We produce per-example scores, confusion matrices, and our proposed grading rubric.
   - Pros: quick, measurable, reproducible; Cons: may miss real-time behavior.
2) Controlled online shadow (live behavior parity)
   - 3–7 day shadow in your staging environment (traffic mirrored to Redwood; no user-facing decisions).
   - Pros: surface runtime/latency/edge-cases; Cons: needs VPC/private deployment and short procurement window.

Recommendation (what I think will move the deal fastest): hybrid two-stage approach
- Stage A (offline) — 2–3 days: run our rubric over a labeled sample to catch precision/regression risks. Owner: Karthik.
- Stage B (controlled shadow) — 3–7 days (select flows only): validate latency, KV-caching behavior, and model fallbacks. Owner: Marissa (trial ops).

Success criteria (proposal — we can calibrate with you):
- Latency: p95 < 500ms for end-to-end inference on representative payloads
- Label-level: F1 >= 0.78 on critical entity set (as measured by offline rubric)
- Safety: false-positive rate for high-risk labels < 3%
- Business metric proxy: automated match rate >= 85% on reviewed set

High-level timeline (if we start next week):
- Oct 17: ClearVale shares sample + schema + redaction rules (deliverable from your side)
- Oct 18–20: Redwood runs baseline offline rubric and shares initial scoreboard
- Oct 21–28: Controlled shadow window (staging/VPC)
- Oct 29: Joint review, decision to proceed to pilot or iterate

Action items / next steps (please confirm by reply):
- Morgan: confirm you can share a 2k-row labeled subset + redaction guidance by EOD Oct 17.
- Marissa: I’ll share the rubric spreadsheet and the ingest checklist (attached).
- Karthik: flags on metric thresholds or additional tests we should run?
- Rachel (procurement): can you own a short statement of work for private staging access if ClearVale prefers that route?

Attachments: trial-eval-rubric-v1.xlsx, sample-ingest-checklist.md
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4892

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Morgan Ellis <morgan@clearvale.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: ClearVale Eng Team <eng-team@clearvale.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation-track recommendation & trial acceptance checklist

Thanks, Vivek — that is super helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Data residency / compliance: 
   - We can supply a labeled 2k subset but it must remain inside ClearVale's staging VPC. We cannot upload PHI to external buckets.
   - For shadowing, we require that the model run inside our environment (either Redwood Private or a short-term VPC peering with strict egress controls).
2) Definition: "controlled shadow" — what do you mean by "select flows only"? We have three flows: intake, coding-suggest, and post-review.
   - We'd want to shadow only coding-suggest for the first pass (intake has downstream legal hooks).
3) Grading rubric example: can you share one populated example row (how you score FP/ FN and severity weights)?

Procurement note: I’ll need a one-page SOW for an initial staging license. We are prepared to sign but routing is 5–7 business days inside ClearVale.

If we can get the rubric example and a clear deployment model for private evaluation, we can commit to the Oct 17 data handoff.

-Morgan
Lead Product Manager | ClearVale Health
morgan@clearvale.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation-track recommendation & trial acceptance checklist

Morgan — perfect, thank you for the clear constraints. Quick answers and a slightly updated plan given procurement timing: 

1) Compliance / deployment options:
   - Option A (preferred): Redwood Private in your staging VPC. We ship a small controller and inference runtime (no telemetry off by default), runs inside your network. Requires short SOW + access window.
   - Option B (if procurement delays): you sanitize/anonymize the 2k sample and we run offline only (no PHI leaves your environment).

2) Controlled shadow scope: agreed — we will shadow only the coding-suggest flow and limit payload size to production-sampled snippets (you'll define sample rate). We will surface only telemetry, not user-facing decisions.

3) Grading rubric: attached is trial-eval-rubric-v1.xlsx — I populated one example row and the scoring weights (columns: gold_label, model_prediction, severity_weight, TP/FP/FN, score). Karthik, can you review weights?

Updated timeline (contingent on procurement):
- Oct 16 (EOD): I’ll put a one-page SOW draft in the HubSpot deal and ping procurement. (Rachel owning)
- If SOW completes by Oct 20: start Private deploy Oct 25 and shadow Oct 26–30.
- If SOW takes longer: we proceed with sanitized offline run Oct 18–20, then re-evaluate shadow start dates.

Owners (confirmed):
- Trial ops / runbook: Marissa Cole
- Eval rubric & metrics: Karthik Iyer
- Procurement / SOW: Rachel Kim
- Customer eng contact: Morgan Ellis

Next steps: I’ll upload a populated rubric example and the ingest checklist to the Drive link; Morgan, please reply with the preferred sample redaction guidance (PII/PHI columns to remove).

Thanks — Vivek
